title: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
relevance: Demonstrates that deep learning can predict complex structural properties from sequence data with remarkable accuracy. Provides the analogical blueprint for learning the Collatz delay function from binary representations.

title: Attention, Learn to Solve Routing Problems!
relevance: Shows that attention-based neural networks can learn effective heuristics for combinatorial optimization problems from data. Relevant architecture and training methodology for learning the structure of the Collatz delay landscape.

title: Neural Combinatorial Optimization with Reinforcement Learning
relevance: Pioneering work on using neural networks with reinforcement learning to solve combinatorial optimization problems. Establishes the paradigm of learning optimization heuristics that can be applied to delay maximization in the Collatz setting.
